interpretation: Disallowing nonzero relabeling reduces the selected modified-Molt program to about0.6385, while unchanged code scores about0.9774 in these repeats. This supports relabeling as a useful component of this one generated program, not superiority of an evolution framework. Timing and random trajectories can change when moves are disabled; not a deterministic isolated numerical effect.
scope: 150 public training cases, both original CPU slots; four checks all valid; no model or held-out access
next_framework_implication: Useful search-space changes can require a valid but initially weak intermediate implementation; evaluate proposal maturation and credit against noise before assuming a lower threshold suffices.
